requestBody.query: What are the devices and platforms where I can stream TSN?

200.answer:
You can stream TSN content on various devices and platforms.

These include iPads, iPhones with iOS 15+, Android smartphones and tablets with version 8.0+, and Samsung Smart TVs from 2017 and above. You can also use Xbox One, Apple TV with tvOS 14+, LG Smart TVs (2018+), Roku TV, Amazon Fire TV Stick, and Android TV.

Android: Download the app from the Google Play Store. Alternately, From the home screen on your device, select the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android) icon.

The TSN app is developed by Bell Media that gives Bell TV customers who subscribe to TSN as part of their programming package with access to TSN content on demand through computers and mobile devices using iOS and Android operating systems, as well as select Connected TVs. The app is available at no charge. However, watching TSN on your computer or mobile device will count toward your monthly Internet or mobile data usage.
